body.statement: Population forward greedy satisfies \[F(S_g)\ge\left\{1-\left(1-\frac{\Gamma}{k}\right)^k\right\}\mathrm{OPT}\ge(1-e^{-\Gamma})\mathrm{OPT}.\] On the event \(\max_{|S|\le k}|\widehat B(S)-B(S)|\le\epsilon\), empirical forward greedy satisfies \[F(\widehat S)\ge\left\{1-\left(1-\frac{\Gamma}{k}\right)^k\right\}\mathrm{OPT}-4k\epsilon.\]
body.justification: This theorem translates the model-specific frontier into the performance guarantee needed by a budget-constrained analyst.
body.gap: The recurrence is generic machinery from Das--Kempe and Bian et al.; the new input is the sharp causal Gaussian certificate supplied by the preceding theorems.
body.consumer: A baseline-panel designer obtains both a population approximation factor and a finite estimation-error tolerance for the chosen panel.
